name: paint-stroke
about: Four strokes across a blank 1080p canvas with the brush named in `brush`, each 70% of the width in 1.5 s at 120 events a second — the gesture behind every drawing-latency report. Measures the UI cost of each pointer batch (stroke.move), how long ink took to reach the screen (pen.screen, tip.screen), each live pass of a textured or simulated brush (live.pass) and how many points behind the pen it landed (live.behind), and the pen-up commit (stroke.commit). Swept over `sizes`, smallest first, because large brushes are where drawing falls over; --sizes replaces the list and --brush builtin-ink is the control. The four rows are 162 px apart, so from about 150 px up the strokes overlap and a wet brush re-wets its last one — which is what a large brush does.
